cases.title: Karaoke lyrics with color wipe
cases.note: Two lines of outlined lyrics; each character turns blue as it is sung, over a slow street scene.
cases.note_zh: 两行带描边的歌词，唱到哪个字就变成蓝色，背景是缓慢移动的街景。

cases.title: Same clip, four kinds of hint
cases.note: Same weights: the mask read as a hole, the mask read as a hint, a hand-placed box, and no hint at all. The box was given as coordinates, so it is not drawn.
cases.note_zh: 同一套权重：把 mask 当作洞、把 mask 当作提示、手动给定的框、完全不给提示。框以坐标形式给出，画面上没有画出。

cases.title: A whole music video in one run
cases.note: The full five-minute video was processed end to end; this stretch near the end crosses a shot cut.

cases.title: 480p anime dialogue
